```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
```

Proportion of manually confirmed gene / participant pairs prioritized within
the top *N* Exomiser ranks, per run. Needs the counts written by
`01_benchmarking_combine_exomiser_results_multirun.Rmd`.

## Data

```{r data}
# Run folder -> legend label (legend order follows this order)
runs <- c(
  "SKSC_3_MAF1per_herIncluded_onlyKS" = "KSD",
  "SKSC_3_MAF1per_herIncluded"        = "KSD+",
  "SKSC_3_MAF1per"                    = "KSD+, any inh."
)

# Denominator: all manually confirmed gene / participant pairs
n_total <- nrow(read_manual_genes())
message("n_total (gene / participant pairs): ", n_total)

rank_data <- names(runs) %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(\(run) read_delim(counts_file(run), delim = " ",
                        col_names = c("MAX_RANK", "N"), show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  list_rbind(names_to = "run") %>%
  mutate(prop = N / n_total,
         run  = factor(runs[run], levels = runs))
```

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 8}
rank_plot <- ggplot(rank_data, aes(x = MAX_RANK, y = prop, colour = run)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Exomiser rank",
       y = "Proportion of established gene-participant pairings prioritized") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text  = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.position        = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.6, 0.2),
        legend.direction       = "vertical",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18))

rank_plot
```

## Save

```{r save}
out_name <- paste0("Exomiser_rank_of_target_KS_variants_multiple_runs_comparison", file_suffix)

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0(out_name, ".png")), rank_plot,
       dpi = 350, width = 7, height = 8, bg = "white")
save(rank_plot, file = file.path(images_dir, paste0(out_name, ".RData")))
```
